name: Trezukuzco
backstory: Child of Tamuzco and Trezukar in Terfila; raised alongside settles the house's accounts at the market stalls..., having heard about CONFLICT-01.

criterion.standard: counts a life well spent only if it stayed close to Birth Of Darika 2
criterion.wasted_life: a life spent never once engaging with Birth Of Darika 2
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: works the pre-dawn market crowd for a spot to set a cart, quietly starting his own version of the toll ledger, and keeping his opinion on the old dispute to himself.

arc.premise: Trezukuzco has stopped just spreading word of the birth at market, and started commissioning a small token - cast in the family's own mark - to send along with the news, so the announcement carries something the relations can actually keep.
